summary: Ribbon and trail motion geometry generator for scene actors: tracks a 16-entry 2D/3D path waypoint ring, progression state, a 238-entry ribbon control point history (+0x3C0, stride 0x40), and a 57-entry trail transform sample buffer (+0x3F7C..+0x4A2C, stride 0x30) submitted as a PICA200 vertex strip via 0x006F511C.
